Attendance Management (Admin Override)

Override any staff member's daily attendance. Deductions apply instantly to salary: Absent = 100% of one day's basic salary, Half Day = 50%. Present, Approved Leave, Holiday and Sundays have no deduction. Choose "— No Override (Auto) —" to remove an override. Automatic login marking never overwrites these overrides, and holidays or non-working days are never marked Absent automatically.

Attendance Timing & Rules (this business)

Each business configures its own reporting time, grace period and half-day boundary. Changes affect only this business's staff and salary calculations.

Half Day deduction: 50% of the daily rate (existing policy, unchanged).

Platform Limits Configuration

Platform Settings

Platform Branding

This branding represents the FinTrack Business platform. It appears on the welcome screen, the login screen and other platform-level areas. It is separate from each business's own logo and details.

No Logo

Saving updates the welcome and login screens for all users on their next load. Individual business logos and details are never affected.

Introductory Offer Configuration

Subscription Plan Pricing

Set the subscription amount for each plan. Saved amounts apply to every business admin — new subscriptions and renewals will charge these amounts, and the payment QR code updates automatically.

WhatsApp Message Templates

These messages open in WhatsApp to the business administrator’s registered mobile number when you tap the WhatsApp icon beside a business’s subscription status in the Businesses directory. WhatsApp opens with the message ready — you always tap Send yourself, nothing is sent automatically. An in-app notification is also recorded for that business administrator.

An empty template falls back to its built-in message. Businesses with an active subscription that is not ending soon receive a fixed thank-you message.

Data Retention & Cleanup

Automatic cleanup of eligible operational records and temporary files older than 730 days. Monthly financial summaries, income/expense totals, profit, balances, month-closing records, and subscription/payment histories are preserved indefinitely.

Note: Fully automatic scheduled cleanup requires Firebase Cloud Functions (a paid Firebase service). A manual trigger is provided below, and the Cloud Function code is available in the security section for deployment.

Cleanup Logs

DateRecords CleanedFailuresDetails

Security & Firebase Rules

Platform administrator permissions and business-level data separation are enforced through trusted backend logic and Firebase security rules. Do not rely on frontend visibility alone.

Security rules are active on the Firebase project. They are managed in the Firebase console and are deliberately not displayed here.
